summary: Iteration 26 — Frontend Phase 2 & 3 (Realms sidebar, RealmDetail widget grid, RealmPollWidget, MessagingPopupContext). Test executed against the public preview URL as founder @stealth (auth via POST /api/auth/login + localStorage('ourrealm.access') shortcut). Results: (a) /realms NEW sidebar renders correctly with all advertised testids — realms-sidebar, realms-sidebar-search, the three sort chips realms-sort-recent/favorite/alpha, realms-sidebar-discover, realms-sidebar-create, realms-create-button — and lists 9 realms in both the sidebar and the right-pane Discover grid. (b) Clicking the first realm card lands on /realms/test_realm_iter24 with the expected layout: General Chat panel, People presence panel, and a realm-widgets-grid containing 1 realm-poll-widget-<id> tile (default Poll, question 'What should we do this Friday?', three options). Founder admin chips realm-poll-edit-<wid>, realm-widget-size-<wid>, realm-widget-drag-<wid> are present. (c) BUG: clicking realm-poll-edit-<wid> does NOT reveal the edit form — realm-poll-edit-question never mounts (timed out 30s). The Edit button is found and the click force=True succeeds, but the inline editing state never reflects in the DOM; the poll keeps showing the read-only options view. Suspected cause: RealmDetail re-fetches widgets on an interval (or after a presence/WS event) and passes a freshly-instantiated widget object down to RealmPollWidget, which is keyed on widget.id but is unmounted/remounted by the parent's grid re-render, clearing the local `editing` state. Vote / total updates therefore could not be confirmed via UI. (d) Reorder COULD NOT be exercised because the default realm only seeds ONE widget (the Poll) and there is no visible 'add widget' / widget-library affordance in RealmDetail to bring it to 2+. (e) Resize button realm-widget-size-<wid> is present but its end-to-end behavior was blocked by the same edit-form failure interrupting the script before resize cycled (script flow stopped at the failed assertion). (f) MessagingPopupContext: messaging-popup-layer mounts globally as expected; on /friends only 1 'Message' affordance was found in the rendered DOM (rest of friend rows likely behind a different control), so the multi-window cascade test could not be fully validated. (g) Sanity: /messages shows 'Sign in to use Messenger' in the headless run despite /api/auth/me returning 200 — this is the AuthContext not picking up the token set during the API-login shortcut on every route mount; not necessarily a real bug, but worth verifying with a fresh cookie-based sign-in. (h) /admin and /admin/support also rendered without the founder widgets in this run — same auth-rehydration issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking realm-poll-edit-<wid> does not surface the edit form (realm-poll-edit-question input never appears within 30s, even though the Edit chip itself is found and the click succeeds). Read-only view keeps re-rendering. Likely the parent grid is replacing/remounting the widget node on every refetch, wiping the component-local `editing` state. Repro: founder logs into /realms/test_realm_iter24 → click Edit → no form. RCA candidates: (1) RealmDetail polls /communities/realm/:id/widgets on a short interval and the widget object identity changes each tick → React unmounts (key only by widget.id should prevent this, so verify); (2) onChanged in RealmPollWidget propagates upstream and the upstream setState resets the editing flag; (3) presence/WS event refresh.

Default realm is seeded with ONLY ONE poll widget and there is no 'add widget' / widget-library UI exposed in /realms/:id for the admin to create a second widget. This makes the Phase 2 reorder test (drag tile A onto tile B) unreachable from the UI in the current build. Either expose an 'Add widget' button on the realm widgets grid for admins, or seed two default widgets per realm.

After authenticating via POST /api/auth/login (the documented shortcut also writes localStorage('ourrealm.access')), several routes render their unauthenticated state on a fresh navigation: /messages → 'Sign in to use Messenger'; /admin/support → no AdminUserControlWidget / AdminPasswordResetWidget; /friends only 1 'Message' button. Yet /api/auth/me returns 200 with the founder user the entire time, and /realms/:id renders authenticated UI (admin chips visible). Suggests the AuthContext rehydrates on the initial App mount but does not refresh on every route push, OR a few routes are using a stricter check (e.g., cookie-only) than the rest. For UI testability this is the bigger blocker — please confirm AuthContext.user is rehydrated from localStorage('ourrealm.access') on every protected route, or document the canonical login path for headless tests.

action_items: [HIGH] Investigate why RealmPollWidget editing state never lands in the DOM after Edit is clicked on /realms/test_realm_iter24. Most likely the parent's widgets refetch is forcing a remount; verify the map key is stable (widget.id) AND that the parent doesn't pass a new array reference unless content actually changed. Consider lifting `editing` into RealmDetail or memoizing the widget objects.

critical_code_review_comments: MessagingPopupContext.jsx — sound implementation: Esc → close top-most via focusZ ordering, cascade math (32px stepped, clamped to 4 cols), mobile branch forces fixed center + disables drag, zIndex 60 + (focusZ % 1000) keeps focus stacking sane. No issues.

RealmWidgetGrid.jsx — HTML5 native drag with optimistic local order then POST reorder; resize is a single PATCH /communities/realm/:id/widgets/:wid {size}. Good. No deps. One nit: when isAdmin flips while a drag is in-flight, dragId state isn't cleared — minor.
RealmPollWidget.jsx — vote and saveOptions both surface backend errors via err state; PostUrl shapes match backend routes. The edit-state-not-rendering issue is likely upstream, not in this file.

Realms.jsx — sidebar implementation is clean (RealmCard + Sidebar + CreateRealmModal). Note: the `mine` Promise.all branch just re-fetches /communities/realms a second time (no separate membership endpoint), which is a small wasted round-trip — flag for cleanup.
Default poll only — RealmDetail likely needs an 'Add widget' control to make Phase 2 reorder testable; track as MEDIUM.

rca of the issue: Likely cause of the Edit-not-rendering bug: RealmDetail re-fetches /communities/realm/:id/widgets on a timer (or after a chat/presence WS tick) and the new widget array contains freshly-cloned widget objects. If the JSX maps the array WITHOUT a stable React key (or with an index key, or the grid container is itself unmounted/remounted), RealmPollWidget loses its local `editing` state every refresh. Fastest mitigation: lift the editing flag into a useRef-backed Map keyed on widget.id at the RealmDetail level, OR confirm `key={w.id}` is set on the widget map AND that the parent doesn't replace the grid component on each refetch. Reorder/seed gap is a product-spec gap, not a runtime bug.
